description:
Surfaced 2026-05-07 by MAJOR PLINY in ariadne-core-workspace during ariadne--2tz dispatch. Real bug, recurring, small fix.

## Symptom

ariadne-core-workspace .git/config exhibited internally inconsistent state:
- extensions.worktreeconfig = true (set so per-worktree core.longpaths=true would activate on Windows NTFS worktrees)
- core.repositoryformatversion = 0

Git docs require version 1 when ANY extension is set. Modern git tolerates the mismatch silently. go-git (the library bw v0.12.3 uses) does not — every bw call in the workspace failed with:

    error: open repo: core.repositoryformatversion does not support extension: worktreeconfig

## Diagnostic path

PLINY's first attempt: bump core.repositoryformatversion to 1. INSUFFICIENT — go-git rejects worktreeconfig at any format version, not just version 0.

Fix that worked (promote-and-drop):
1. git config core.longpaths true   # promote to main .git/config; applies to all worktrees
2. git config --unset extensions.worktreeconfig
3. git config core.repositoryformatversion 0   # revert; no extensions remain
4. Verify: bw prime succeeds.

Reasoning ratification (PRINCIPAL 2026-05-07): core.longpaths has no reason to vary per-worktree on Windows. Every worktree on NTFS wants longpaths enabled. The per-worktree scope was incidental, not structural. Promoting to main config restores semantic correctness AND unblocks go-git.

## Scope

1. **Audit candidate workspaces.** Known orphan-branch workspaces with the same likely setup pattern:
   - ariadne-core-workspace: ALREADY FIXED 2026-05-07 by PLINY.
   - the-stoa: UNVERIFIED — same fix likely needed.
   - Any other orphan-branch workspaces on this machine: UNVERIFIED — enumerate via 'find ~/claude_projects -name .git -type d' or equivalent and check each.

2. **For each affected workspace:** apply promote-and-drop, verify bw prime succeeds, post one-line result on this ticket.

3. **Locate root cause.** Find the workspace-creation script/skill/doc that established the broken pattern in the first place. Likely candidates:
   - the-stoa substrate doc describing orphan-branch workspace setup
   - User-level CLAUDE.md Windows-discipline section
   - Any onboarding skill that creates workspaces (tier2-project-onboarding or similar)
   Update the source so new workspaces created by the same process don't reintroduce the mismatch.

4. **Documentation.** Add a one-line diagnostic snippet to MAJOR_PLINY.md (or substrate equivalent) so the next time bw fails with the worktreeconfig error, the fix is one substrate-lookup away rather than a fresh re-derivation. Snippet:

    'bw prime fails with go-git core.repositoryformatversion does not support extension: worktreeconfig — promote core.longpaths to main .git/config, drop extensions.worktreeconfig, revert formatversion to 0.'

## Gauntlet

SKIP DAEDALUS, ARGUS, ADA, VERA, ZENO. Each affected workspace is a 3-command fix; CATO eyeball verifies post-fix bw prime works. Documentation update is a single edit to a single file with no behavior change.

## Sequencing

Not blocking xft.7 cluster work. Substrate hygiene. Recommend running BEFORE any new workspace is created (so the broken pattern doesn't propagate to a freshly-spawned workspace and silently break bw there).

## Out of scope

- bw v0.12.3 upstream fix. The go-git strictness is what it is; we adjust workspace config to match, not the other way around.
- Migration to a different bw version. Separate question.

## Empirical anchor

PLINY surface 2026-05-07 in ariadne-core-workspace; CATO verdict + ariadne--2tz close-out (PR denson/ariadne-core#20, SHA 60d7983) captured the diagnostic chain. Workspace bw config side-quest noted in PLINY's ship-surface comment.
